maps.name: Blue Flame Cup
maps.blurb: A forest around a lake island with fog. One Blue Flame Cup per player hides in it: unlock one and you lose your wood, sheep and hay.

maps.name: Hidden Vault
maps.blurb: A diamond with an 8 sits in the middle, buried under two rings of fog. Blue Flame Cups hide in the fog: unlock one and you lose your wood, sheep and hay.

maps.name: Hay Hollows
maps.blurb: A big island of hay, all numbered 6, 8 or 9, with random 3:1 harbors on every side. Build a settlement after setup and the hay beside it turns into other resources.

maps.name: US 2.0
maps.blurb: The United States four times as big: 144 hexes, the Great Lakes in the north and 25 harbors. Slide the map to see all of it.
